what.text: This page follows refugees from Venezuela living in Paraguay, as counted by UNHCR at the end of each year.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 3041 Venezuelan refugees in Paraguay, 0.7% of all refugees from Venezuela.
The largest numbers of Venezuelan refugees live in Spain, Brazil, the United States and Mexico.

why.text: The fact pack records no armed conflict and no dated events for Venezuela, so it does not say why people left.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2021 to 2025.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2016 at 5 refugees.
The figure was at its highest, 4730, at the end of 2024, and was lower at the end of 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Paraguay.
These are year-end totals for Paraguay only, reported to UNHCR.
